title_sq: Okazion!!Tek Univers City, Shitet Dyqan Ideal Per Investim !!!
description_sq: Okazion!!Tek Univers City, Shitet Dyqan me verande ideal per investim. Dyqani ka siperfaqe bruto 101 m2, neto 70.04 m2, siperfaqe verande 31 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin zero te nje pallati 8-katesh i cili ndodhet prane parkut te kompleksit, organizohet si nje ambient i vetem openspace dhe nje tualet. Lartesia e dyqanit eshte 5 m. Ajo cka e ben me shume terheqes ambientin per te zhvilluar biznesin tuaj eshte fasada e xhamit qe i jep mundesi shume te mire reklamimi per biznesin qe deshironi te realizoni. Dyqani eshte i pershtatshem per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi. Kompleksi ku ndodhet ky dyqan ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, eshte lehtesisht i aksesueshem dhe ka cilesi shume te larte ndertimi.
title_en: Opportunity!! In Univers City, ideal store for investment!!!
description_en: Opportunity!! In Univers City, Shop for sale with veranda, ideal for investment. The store has a gross area of ​​101 m2, net area of ​​70.04 m2, veranda area of ​​31 m2 and is located on the ground floor of an 8-story building which is located near the park of the complex, it is organized as a single open space environment and a toilet. The height of the shop is 5 m. What makes the environment for developing your business more attractive is the glass facade, which gives very good advertising opportunities for the business you want to do. The store is suitable for different types of business. The complex where this store is located offers all the necessary facilities, is easily accessible and has a very high quality of construction.
